resources.string: One per line. Leave empty to use the built-in phrases.

string-array.name: typing_phrases
string-array.item: I am awake and ready to start the day
Good morning, today is going to be a great day
The early bird catches the worm
Every morning is a fresh start
I will drink a glass of water and stretch
Small steps every day lead to big results
Rise and shine, the sun is already up
I choose to get out of bed right now
Today I will do one thing that makes me proud
Breakfast is waiting for me in the kitchen
My future self will thank me for getting up
The snooze button is not my friend
I slept well and now it is time to move
Wake up, sit up, stand up and go
The best way to start is to begin
Fresh air and daylight help me wake up
I keep my promises, including this one
A good morning makes a good day
Open the curtains and let the light in
One more minute in bed will not help
